articles.summary: SINGAPORE, Aug. 28, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- GCL Global Holdings Ltd (NASDAQ: GCL) (“GCL” or the “Company”), a leading provider of games and entertainment, today announced its subsidiary, 2Game Digital, a global leader in gaming ecommerce, esports and competitive gaming ecosystems, entered into an agreement with a technology service provider integrated with KuCoin, a leading cryptocurrency exchange, to allow KuCoin Pay to be used as an alternative payment method on 2Game.com’s ecommerce store.2G
articles.title: GCL Subsidiary, 2Game Digital, Partners with KuCoin Pay to Accept Secure Crypto Payments in Real Time
